### Summary
Adds a new session creation utility. The token generation uses `Math.random()`, which is cryptographically insecure.

### Findings
- **[critical]** auth/session.js:2 — `Math.random()` is not cryptographically secure.
- **[warning]** auth/session.js:2 — The token is only ~10 characters.
- **[warning]** auth/session.js — No expiry is enforced.

### Verdict
Changes requested.
